shortDescription: The Star Entertainment Group Limited ASX:SGR:

children: AS AT 30 JUNE 2026, THE STAR HAD CASH AND CASH EQUIVALENTS OF A$267 MILLION
CONTINUES TO BE MATERIAL UNCERTAINTIES IN EXISTENCE THAT CAST SIGNIFICANT DOUBT AS TO GROUP’S  ABILITY TO REMAIN GOING CONCERN
JULY 2026 COMBINED REVENUE FOR THE STAR SYDNEY AND THE STAR GOLD COAST OF A$92.4 MILLION
ONGOING INITIATIVES CONTINUING TO SEEK FURTHER IMPROVEMENT DURING FY27
COMPLETION OF A$300 MILLION EQUITY INVESTMENT FROM BALLY’S AND INVESTMENT HOLDINGS
CURRENTLY EXPECTED TO SATISFY CONDITIONS PRECEDENT IN 2H CY2026, BY NO LATER THAN 31 MARCH 2027 FOR JVP TRANSACTION SECOND STAGE
FROM FY27, GROUP WILL TRANSITION FROM FIXED CORPORATE COST ALLOCATION METHODOLOGY TO DIRECT ATTRIBUTION APPROACH
